import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u047/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The two panels are separated by a solid divider row or column.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and all(grid[r][c] not in grid[r][:c] + grid[r][c+1:] for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col+1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        mismatch_color = min(shared)
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else mismatch_color for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row+1:]
        shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
        mismatch_color = min(shared)
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else mismatch_color for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
    raise ValueError("No solid divider found")
'''
p=programs/'task-fd6de915.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
